description: Buying rental cars: only once the driver owns a car, with an expiry, and with an insurance amplifier when the driver has none, which repairs every car.

steps.note: Registration logs in too: launcher token ...0001.
Permanent session ...0002, with no drivers yet.
Driver 100, whose starting items include an insurance amplifier.
The data's one rental car (SRV-CAR56, a day long) is disabled, so it can't be bought.
Enabling it, and giving the driver the cash for several. Static data: restored in the last step.
sql: UPDATE product SET enabled = 1 WHERE productId = 'SRV-CAR56'
UPDATE persona SET cash = 2000000 WHERE ID = 100

steps.note: A rental needs a car of one's own first: the EngineException becomes Fail_MaxStackOrRentalLimit.
Now the rental: it expires in a day; the driver already has insurance, so none is added; owning a rental isn't ACH_OWN_CAR.
Damaging both cars and taking the insurance away.
sql: UPDATE car SET durability = 40 WHERE personaId = 100

steps.note: A second rental adds an insurance amplifier, which repairs every car.
Three cars, two of them rentals, all repaired.

sql: UPDATE product SET enabled = 0 WHERE productId = 'SRV-CAR56'
